integrity: The proof is exact: a convexity-based centralization lemma reduces the problem to equal half-diagonals, the regular-polygon radial function gives the feasible diagonal length, and a sharp trigonometric inequality resolves the only off-vertex regime. A numerical angular sweep was used only as a sanity check, not as evidence for the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers maximum-area rectangles in regular even Euclidean polygons only. It does not classify regular odd polygons, maximum-perimeter rectangles, fixed-aspect-ratio rectangles, or arbitrary centrally symmetric polygons.
title: Exact maximum-area rectangles in every regular even polygon
